versions.changelog: Workspace backups now encrypted by default (contain personal data). Both full and workspace files use same passphrase. Added explicit Requirements section to SKILL.md body.
Added full metadata declaration (required/optional binaries, env vars, credentials). Clarified workspace-only restores need no gateway restart. Expanded description.
Security: replaced shell source for credential files with safe key=value parser. No config.json shipped.
Confirmed no config.json shipped in package — destinations are always empty until user configures via setup flow

Dual backup: every run creates both a full encrypted backup (disaster recovery) and a workspace-only backup (agent brain, safe for any environment). New --workspace-only restore flag. Upload script now handles both files. Removed curl|bash install suggestions.
Security fixes: ship clean default config.json with no destinations, remove curl|bash install suggestions, local-only by default
Initial release: encrypted local + cloud backups (S3, R2, B2, GCS, Google Drive, rsync) with interactive setup, auto-prune, and portable mode
